title: Repeat
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox HDL Support/Signal Operations/Repeat.md
text: Resample input at higher rate by repeating values, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial conditions} sets Initial conditions; {Repetition count source} sets the mode of specifying repetition count, {Repetition count, L}, {Maximum repetition factor, Lmax} sets the maximum repetition count, {Input processing} sets the method to process input signals Columns and {Rate options} sets the method by which block upsamples input Enforce single-rate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Repetition count source
params.values: Mode of specifying repetition count Dialog parameter (default) | Input port

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process input signals Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Method by which block upsamples input Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing
